I checked this by reading the code at 1f24aba with `git show`. I did not build or run anything, so there was no worktree to create or remove.

- **Collection is too narrow.** In `src/rules/util/text.ts` (the function starts at about line 100), `corpus()` collects these tool fields: `t.name`, `t.title`, `t.annotations.title` and `t.description`. From `inputSchema`, `walkSchema` collects only `v.node.description`, and only when `v.viaProperty` is set. Property `title`, `enum`, `const`, `default`, `examples` and property keys are never added to the corpus. The rest of `corpus()` covers only instructions and the descriptions of prompts, prompt arguments, resources and resource templates.
- **No other rule covers these fields.**
  - `hiddenChars` is defined and called only in `injection.ts:78` and `:104`, by INJ-001 over `corpus(snap)`.
  - POL builds its own text in `policy.ts:57`, from the name, title and description only.
  - The other `walkSchema` callers look at `enum` only for structure: TOOL-023/024 for read/write verbs, and ANN for openWorld. None of them scan for hidden characters or injection.
  - `schema.ts:292-294` only lists `title`, `default` and `examples` as known keywords for the typo check.
- **The spec has the same gap.** `docs/design/spec.md:80` (§1.5) lists the allowed corpus `where` values, and every schema entry in that list is `param.description`. So the code follows the spec, and the gap is in the spec. That matches the claim.
- **Not a known item.** I found no matching entry in the confirmed, refuted or deferred items of `FINDINGS.md` or `REMEDIATION.md`. The only nearby mention is `FINDINGS.md:2788`, which is about truncation in `capStrings` and is a different issue.

Why I rate it medium: hosts pass the whole `inputSchema` to the model, and tag characters are the hard error class (INJ-001). Hiding them in `enum`, `default` or `title` gets past the linter, and the same text in a description is reported as an error. It is a missed detection rather than a false positive, and fixing it needs changes to both the spec and the code.
